senses.gloss: m. (v. preced.; Pers. Khorengah, Arab. Khawarnak, Fl.) dining place, dining hall in the garden.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 32:50">Targ. Y. Deut. XXXII, 50</cite>, <he>א׳ … קי דמלכיא</he> a royal banqueting hall (put up for the wedding).

<cite ref="Taanit 14b">Taan. 14ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Megillah 5b">Meg. 5ᵇ</cite> (distinguishing between <cite ref="B00953"><he>בנין</he></cite>, erection of a building, and <cite ref="N00563"><he>נטיעה</he></cite>, putting up a temporary structure), what is meant by ‘putting up a tent of joy?’—<he>זה הנוטע אכ׳ של מלכים</he> Ms. M. (Ar. <cite ref="K00001"><he>כ׳</he></cite>; ed. <cite ref="A01133"><he>אב׳</he></cite>, corr. acc.) it means one putting up a regal banqueting tent (for his son’s wedding).
<cite ref="Eruvin 25b">Erub. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>אכ׳ וכ׳</he> (ed. <cite ref="A01133"><he>אב׳</he></cite>) the Resh Gelutha was to have a banquet (on a Sabbath) in his garden.
